test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

I have never seen someone so easily scared. She is **so** **nervous**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Afraid of one's own shadow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Afraid of one's own shadow"** means someone who is extremely nervous or easily frightened. (अपनी ही परछाई से डरना)

 
 
• **Example:** After the burglary, she became so paranoid that she was afraid of her own shadow.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In seventh heaven** (सातवें आसमान पर): Being extremely happy.

 
 
• **Example:** When they announced her name as the winner, she felt like she was in seventh heaven.
 
 
 
• **Spilled the beans** (राज़ खोल देना): To disclose a secret.
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise birthday party.
 
 
 
• **Lost cause** (निराशाजनक स्थिति): Something that has no chance of success.
 
 
• **Example:** Trying to convince him to change his habits is a lost cause.
